guarantees.claim: rst_done is asynchronously cleared to 0 when rst_ni is low.
When rst_ni is high, rst_done is set to 1 on the next rising edge of clk_i and remains 1 thereafter.

uncertain_points.claim: rst_done is set to 1 once after initial reset and never cleared. It is unclear whether this behavior matches the intended reset-done semantics for the KMAC block, especially if a software-triggered reset (without toggling rst_ni) is expected to re-assert the reset-done indication.
uncertain_points.cond: unknown; may depend on system reset architecture
uncertain_points.risk: If a local reset is expected to re-initialize KMAC but does not toggle rst_ni, a stale rst_done=1 could cause downstream logic to bypass security initialization sequences, potentially leaking secret data or allowing operation without proper state clearing.
